name: Edward Zaborowski
biography: started working in the computer security field when he enlisted in the US Air Force. During his enlistment he had the opportunity to help provide a wide array of security services such as intrusion detection, penetration testing, and incident response. He separated from the USAF in 2001 to continue his career in computer security and is currently working as a senior security engineer for Apptis based in Chantilly, VA. When not he's not delving into security, he also enjoys as hobbies programming and video games (or programming video games) and can usually be found pwning or being pwned -- usually the latter -- in Call of Duty or DotA.
